title: AI Bill — original editorial score

created_for.film: OpenAI Halved My $200 Plan. So I Priced My Own AI Bill.

decision.choice: generate an original Eleven Music score
decision.prior_library_search: asset-decision-log.md 'Music decision' (2026-09-30): no approved or rights-cleared bed in the asset library

status: candidate — awaiting Aaron's listening approval and plan-tier confirmation; not used in any render yet
model_choice_note: music_v2 chosen over music_v2_5 because the Eleven Music Model-Specific Terms (last updated 26 May 2026) name v1 and v2 explicitly; same model as the 2026-08-02 and 2026-08-19 scores.
mode: composition_plan (11 chunks aligned to the narration section boundaries; seed not supported with a plan)
output_format: pcm_48000 = headerless signed 16-bit little-endian, stereo, 48 kHz (verified: 97,912,320 bytes = 509.96 s stereo; mono/float interpretations decode as noise)

direction.palette: restrained modern documentary bed: soft felt piano (low-middle register), light plucked/soft-mallet eighth-note pulse, warm low pad
direction.speech_clearance: 1-4 kHz kept light; no lead line in the voice range

generations.rejected_because: cold open near-silent (0-6.6 s below -55 dB, section at -45 LUFS), darker than take A (nothing above ~3 kHz), -29.1 LUFS overall
first 29.7 s digital silence (cold-open chunk not rendered); large struck-chord swells every ~5.9 s (LRA 13.5 LU), which is not a steady bed

generations.note: 12 s prompt-mode test ('bright airy felt piano with glockenspiel shimmer') to confirm pcm_48000 is not band-limited; it carried content to 12-20 kHz. Audio discarded.

stitching.note: Single continuous generation; no crossfades. Section changes happen inside the model at the chunk boundaries below, so key and tempo stay continuous.

sections.label: Cold Open
sections.intent: light tension, sparse pulse (cold open: the meter hit 100%, the email)

sections.label: What Changed
sections.intent: steady, neutral, forward motion (what changed / $20 per unit)

sections.label: The Bill
sections.intent: focus, a touch more weight (my 30-day bill)

sections.label: The Re-read
sections.intent: the one gentle lift; repeating loop-like figure (the re-read reveal)

sections.label: End Card
sections.intent: soft tail into the brand end card

post_processing.chain: volume=+3.0 dB; 50 ms fade-in; pad 40 ms of silence to 24,480,000 samples; qsin fade-out 504.5-510.0 s; triangular dither to s16
post_processing.eq: none; the take is already light in 1-4 kHz (see qa.band_levels)

master.ducking: unducked; duck under narration at mix time

qa.clipping: none (sample peak -7.03 dBFS, true peak -7.0 dBTP)
qa.silence_note: Only the end-card tail (506.6-510.0 s) falls below -55 dB. The score enters ~0.8 s after frame 0 (rises from the noise floor to -46 dBFS RMS by 1.5 s).
qa.section_changes: Across every chunk boundary except 466.2 s, 0.5 s RMS stays within the bed's normal 2-4 dB fluctuation. The only jumps of 6 dB or more are the fade-in at 0-1.5 s and the 466 s breath.
qa.breath_at_466s: At the ending boundary the bed breathes: a smooth ~4 s dip (465.4-469.5 s) to -46 dBFS RMS at 467.2 s (about 19 dB below the bed), then rebuilds by 470 s. Not a silence gap and not a cut. It lands on the narration's section change into 'A Bill I Can Finally Read'. Listen at 460-475 s before approving.
qa.tempo: The onset-envelope autocorrelation gives the same periodicities (~1.09 s and ~0.35 s) in all ten sections, so there is no tempo drift. The exact BPM was not verified against the prompted 82.
qa.key: Pitch-class energy is centered on D, with A as the fifth, in all ten sections (D 64-91%, A 8-31%, with F#/G colour). There is no key change.
qa.band_note: Very dark spectrum: the 1-4 kHz speech band is 20-55 dB below the low end, so there is no masking risk. The trade-off is that there is almost nothing above 4 kHz, so soloed it reads warm and muffled rather than airy.
qa.stereo: side (L-R) energy -31.3 dB vs mid -26.6 dB on raw take: genuinely stereo
qa.vocals_drums: Plan chunks contain no lyric lines, only bracketed section names and brace directions. Nothing above 4 kHz means no cymbal or hi-hat energy. Vocal absence was not machine-verified; confirm by ear.
qa.cold_open: The cold open sits at -28.4 LUFS, 6 LU under the bed, and rises from about -46 to about -29 dBFS RMS over 2-20 s. That makes it a sparse, quiet entrance that joins the steady bed at 24 s.
qa.section_dynamics: The mid-film sections span only -21.5 to -22.1 LUFS; the re-read is the loudest at -21.5. Energy shifts are textural rather than level-based, which suits a bed that must never compete with the voice.

audition.mix: narration unchanged (mono, center, -14.6 LUFS in stereo); score at fixed -13.1 dB = -34.6 LUFS, i.e. 20 LU under the voice; 0.5 s fade-in and 1 s fade-out
audition.covers: end of '30-day bill' into 'the re-read' lift (205.6 s)

rights.plan_tier: paid (Creator or higher), confirmed by Aaron 2026-09-30
rights.tier_evidence: ElevenLabs documents the Music API as available to paid subscribers. Four music generations succeeded with this key on 2026-09-30, and earlier reviews (2026-08-03) recorded a paid plan. Both are consistent with a paid tier, but neither proves it.
rights.terms: Eleven Music Model-Specific Terms, last updated 26 May 2026 (https://elevenlabs.io/eleven-music-model-specific-terms); cover Music Models v1 and v2

what_terms_allow.media_rights_all_self_serve_tiers: All online and offline commercial use permitted, except film, TV, radio and Studio Games. A monetized YouTube explainer is online commercial use, so it is allowed on Free through Business.
what_terms_allow.attribution: Free plan only: must credit Eleven Music wherever the output is published. Paid plans: no attribution required.
what_terms_allow.streaming_rights: Distribution on third-party music streaming platforms: prohibited on Free and Starter; allowed on Creator and above. Not relevant to a YouTube video.
what_terms_allow.music_libraries_repositories: Prohibited on all self-serve tiers. Do not upload this score to a stock/music library. The private asset-library catalog is internal indexing, not distribution.
what_terms_allow.plan_change: Output keeps the rights of the plan in effect when it was created.
what_terms_allow.content_id: Not addressed by the terms. Do not register this score with YouTube Content ID.

rights.action_needed: Aaron: confirm the active plan on the ElevenLabs Subscription page. On any paid plan, publication on monetized YouTube is covered with no credit needed. If the account is Free, add 'Music: Eleven Music' to the description.
rights.not_a_paid_tier_flag: cannot confirm — flagged until Aaron checks
rights.author_listening: Aaron approved the score after two under-voice auditions (2026-09-30): 'Works, use it'
